title: Block Melting
description: Melt down variations of blocks into their original form
body:
Allows you to melt down variations of blocks (bricks, chiseled, tiles, etc.) into their original form using a Blast Furnace.

This works with all blocks that can be created in a Stonecutter, exluding slabs since they have a 2:1 ratio.

Idea from [EthosLab](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M-pbAW2To-Y&t=602s) on YouTube
